test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Awadh walks 20m towards West. Then, he turns to his left and walks 10m. Then, he again takes a left turn and walks 10m. Now, he takes a right and again walks 10m. Finally, he takes a right turn and stops after walking 10m. In which direction is the stopping point with respect to the starting point? (all turns are 90° turns only)
solution:
__**Detailed solution**__** ****:**

1) Awadh walks 20m towards West. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6768aa996e73e79bb0c000c44335e21cf654550a942753412b9938c134af9059.png] 

2) Then, he turns to his left and walks 10m

. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80e8f6192a295813d4675cc1ff9c1f00061f152430c15ae9ebd5b93808e1f7ff.png] 

 

3)Then, he again takes a left turn and walks 10m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e68088871fccfce57ec01c148420998e563f03319b50b197ab225615bfd408a3.png] 

4) Now, he takes a right and again walks 10m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60ee334bec0026544639386ce381e19689f104eaf3d465e48ee73ba9d426fd6f.png] 

5) He takes a right turn and stops after walking 10m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad696204ab0a48a1b0cc884347482f8a4bbe52894e215e91e749e40427457866.png] 

Final, direction according to the given information. Hence, he is in** south- west direction** with respect to his starting point.
